messages.1000001:
I'm the Saint Knight Licarn.
You're the hired warrior Limina mentioned, no?
messages.1000002:
You want to hear the story about how
the Elf Rangers were annihilated, don't you?
messages.1000003:
Cardinal Barshival had reason to put into motion the chain of events
that lead to the disaster.
messages.1000004:
Cardinal Barshival asked the Elf Rangers
to look into a recent rash of robberies involving sacred relics.
messages.1000005:
The elite rangers, however,
were ambushed and killed while investigating.
So, Cardinal Barshival, who is of mixed-blood, half human and half elf,
is facing a lot of accusations from the Elf Tribe.
messages.1000006:
Also, judging from the timing of the event,
it seems that there is a collaborator inside the church.
messages.1000009:
Strange...
This tower has stopped functioning.
messages.1000012:
Yes.
Someone is controlling the tower from the outside...
messages.1000013:
There is no way to transport to various levels of tower,
so somebody needs to go through the first floor.
messages.1000014:
I don't have the necessary arms to make it to the first floor
but you could do it for me. Would you?
messages.1000015:
Once you get to the first floor, that may be enough to get
the tower functioning again. Come see me again if that happens.
messages.1000016:
You won't be able to transport directly to a higher level of the tower.
Also, all the Warp Runes that connect each floor are one-way.
Be careful.
messages.1000018:
Thank you.
I can't imagine who is doing this...
messages.1000020: Oh, yeah... the story about the Elf Rangers and the robberies.
messages.1000021: Have you ever heard the name Gawl?
messages.1000022:
Nah, of course not.
In the old days, there was a Saint Knight named Gawl.
messages.1000023:
He was a great knight, but one day
he questioned the methods of the Noil religion, which was taboo...
messages.1000024:
I'm not going to tell you the all the details now,
but the Noil executed him as a traitor.
messages.1000025: Do you want to know how this event might relate to the robberies?
messages.1000026:
Well, just before the robberies of the sacred relics started,
a grave keeper found that Gawl's body had disappeared from his tomb.
messages.1000027:
So, it is said among Saint Knights that
Gawl rose and avenged himself
against the Noils.
messages.1000028:
That's all that I know.
I hope I've helped you somehow.
messages.1000030:
Ha ha ha.
Oh, my old friend in the mining town
told me about you.
messages.1000031:
I can sense your power, which might end up changing the world.
I hope you use that power for good of all of us.
Continue your journey.
